heroLead: We welcome project collaboration with creative, technology, and community partners. Opportunity details are still being prepared.
introLead: Every sector has challenges worth solving together. We look for ideas that give back to the ecosystem.

points.title: Cross-sector
points.text: A project can involve more than one sector in the group.

points.title: District as a laboratory
points.text: T46 provides a real place to try ideas and measure results.

points.title: Shared impact
points.text: We favour collaboration that creates value for many parties.

audienceLead: We look for ideas that can be tested in the ecosystem and benefit many parties.

audienceItems.title: Creative partners
audienceItems.text: Content makers, designers, and experience builders.

audienceItems.title: Technology developers
audienceItems.text: Parties with solutions our units can use.

audienceItems.title: Local communities
audienceItems.text: Groups wanting to run activities in the district.

processLead: Even a simple idea can be a starting point, which we then develop together.

processSteps.title: Pitch your idea
processSteps.text: Tell us what you want to build.

processSteps.title: Mapping
processSteps.text: We identify the most relevant sectors and units.

processSteps.title: Follow-up
processSteps.text: Our team contacts you with the next steps.

closingNote: Criteria and the project list will be updated once agreed.
